text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On our way back from an outing, Mejiro McQueen and I swing by the shopping district.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Oh? A large crowd has gathered over there.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Step right up and try your luck with our New Year's raffle! This year's grand-prize is a hot spring vacation for two!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: First-prize winners get a deluxe carrot hamburger steak! Second-prize winners get a bushel of carrots! And third-prize winners can take home a single carrot!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Don't let this opportunity pass you by! Get a ticket now and spin for your chance to win!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: A raffle… That seems enjoyable. Do you think there's a surefire way to win?
choice_data_list: The only thing you can count on is your luck.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Only my luck?! Then there's no reason to hesitate.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Neither rank nor acquired skill are relevant if it's only a matter of luck.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: In situations such as this, there can be no favoritism. Oh, what a thrill!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I shall get my raffle ticket as soon as possible. I can buy some ribbons or something.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …And so we receive one raffle ticket.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Now, we only have one chance. Let's focus all our energy on this, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As the two of us pray for good luck, we grasp the lever together and turn the raffle tumbler.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A small plastic ball drops from the opening…

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves a grand-prize winner! Come and get the coupon for your hot spring vacation! Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: What? Is this really true?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: We did it, Trainer! We got the jackpot prize!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: A travel voucher for two. I can imagine it now!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Gazing at the autumn leaves, eating delicious food, enjoying a hot bath, and…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: W-w-wait a moment!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: (I've just won a coupon for a hot springs trip! This is an event most unimaginable!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: (I mustn't get ahead of myself; it's unbecoming. I know! I should entrust these to my trainer!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ahem! Now that I think about it, I'm not restricted in the way I choose to use these vouchers.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Here, Trainer. Use them however you like.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: (This is the best option. I maintain proper courtesy, and Trainer will hopefully—)
choice_data_list: No, you should have them. You get to choose.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Th-this puts me in an awkward position! Don't… Wait, whaaat?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: (You dummy! Why are you trying to put it back on me?! Now it seems like I'm the only one desiring this trip.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: (Since it's come to this…)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: …I shall reserve them for later.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes. In the interest of fairness, I am entrusting them to you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I shall decide how to use them only after heavy deliberation. It's an immense privilege, after all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's making a bigger deal of this than necessary. Still, I end up holding on to the coupon in her stead.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Looks like we have another first-prize winner! Congratulations! You get one deluxe carrot hamburger steak!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: My, a carrot hamburger steak! It looks positively scrumptious.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: B-but…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: You should have it. If I ate it, I'd gain wei—I mean, I'd feel terribly guilty.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: You want to eat it, don't you? There's no need to deny yourself the pleasure.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Please, admit you want to eat it! If you don't, I'll end up taking it, you know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Don't "go ahead" me! Why you…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Fine, then we will eat it together. If we each take half, it will be half the calories but all the deliciousness.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: No, it might be double the deliciousness. Or maybe… double the happiness?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: N-never mind me. I'm just a little worked up from winning something so nice.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In the end, we amiably split the hamburger steak and eat it together.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: We got a second-prize winner! It's your lucky day! You're going home with a bushel of carrots!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Second-prize… It's a so-so outcome, yet strangely, I feel a sense of accomplishment.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Who could have imagined that a single piece of paper could be exchanged for so much food? It's an achievement in its own way, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: That, I can accept. Now, let's go.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh, that's right. I ought not to forget the actual prize.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Although, that's not why I wanted to play the raffle.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I simply wanted to have a chance to demonstrate my brilliance. That's all…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Accepting the prize would put me in an awkward position. Just look at how many there are.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In the end, we decide to have the heap of carrots delivered to the Mejiro family estate. Days later, I receive a written invitation to a "carrot banquet."

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Would you lookie here! You've won the third-prize! Here's your carrot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Just one carrot… That's rather depressing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: So this is the limit of my potential… A single carrot…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: By the way, Trainer. Do you know what season follows winter?
choice_data_list: Spring. But why do you ask?
Spring. But why do you ask?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Oh, look at that, a boutique just a few shops down. If I buy some spring clothing there, I may happen to get another raffle ticket.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Then, I would have no choice but to play the raffle again… Please excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I prevent her from wasting any more of her money. She seems very frustrated by the raffle result.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: Ohhh, tough luck! Looks like you pulled a blank one! Take this pack of tissues as a consolation prize.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: You obtained: <itemname>

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Tissues… Hehe… It's exactly what I wanted.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: To wipe away my tears of regret. Ohhh, I thought I had waited until just the right time, too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: No thank you! I… I prefer a tissue!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro McQueen seems so disheartened that I question whether the small package has enough tissues for her.
